newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Aegon up 18.5 pct in 96, sees 10-12 pct rise in 97.
newsitem.headline: Aegon up 18.5 pct in 96, sees 10-12 pct rise in 97.

text.p: Dutch insurer Aegon NV said on Friday its net profit rose 18.5 percent to 1.57 billion guilders in 1996 from 1.32 billion in 1995.
The company raised its dividend to 2.79 guilders per share

"Barring unforeseen exceptional circumstances such as major exchange rate movements and excluding the impact of the Providian acquisition, for 1997 we expect a clear increase of earnings and earnings per share in guilders in the range of 10 to 12 percent," Aegon said in a statement.
"The acquisition of Providian Corporation's insurance activities will have a further positive impact on Aegon's earnings per share," it added.

Aegon announced on December 30 that it would buy the insurance activities of Providian Corp of the U.S. in a deal worth $3.5 billion. It said then that the deal would be closed in the first half of 1997.
